name: lemma
description: Lemma's own plugins. Telepath connects your existing Telegram conversations to Claude over a hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: lemma-telepath
plugins.description: Your existing Telegram conversations, readable by Claude: search the archive, read the documents, photos and transcribed voice inside it, and reply as yourself — over a hosted MCP server. One setup step in Telegram: Settings → My Account → Chat automation → add @lemma_telepath_bot. Open to every account — no Premium.
